model.name: Poolside Laguna S 2.1
model.workload: pp512 attention, M128 physical attention slices

candidate.scope: complete preappended global M128 tiles at absolute start >= 128
candidate.geometry: one wave32, six adjacent query rows, cached KVLiveSpans metadata
candidate.invariants: unchanged visible-key order, wave32 reduction, online-softmax order, PV order, F32 output, resident BF16 KV, and span ABI
candidate.fallbacks: qrow4 at global start 0, all SWA tiles, partial/wrapped/verifier transactions, and unmeasured backends

correctness.red: The focused registry/oracle test initially failed because the global qrow6 wrapper and variant did not exist.
correctness.green: The production M128 cached-preappend fixture is F32 byte-identical to cached-metadata qrow4.
correctness.swa_qrow6: F32 byte-identical but rejected and removed after losing at every stable leaf position

leaf.timing: eleven counter-rotated HIP-event samples of burst 25 at absolute starts 0/128/256/384

rejected_swa_sibling.decision: remove the HIP export, Python wrapper, registry variant, test surface, and harness mode

rocprof.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/laguna-attention-qrow6-rocprof -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_attention_cached_meta_leaf.py --samples 1 --warmups 0 --burst 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-attention-qrow6-rocprof-child.json

decision.next_gate: gfx1151 runtime policy plus repeated complete-state pp512 A/B
decision.reason: global qrow6 is exact and saves 20-28% at every qualified nonzero position; start 0 is neutral and SWA qrow6 is decisively slower
